Yash practised explaining that the material matters, not only weight or size.

end.parentNote: Yash practised explaining how the material a thing is made of affects whether it floats or sinks, rather than looking only at weight or size. Yash gave one correct response without help during two attempts. Yash still mixed up the idea that heavy things always sink and light things always float, and this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, try floating objects of different materials and discuss what happens.
